improvedPrompt:
[IMPROVED_PROMPT]

"Your task is to produce a high-quality, polished image edit that transforms two human subjects into the central, handcrafted figures of a whimsical, stop-motion claymation scene. The subjects must retain their core likeness while being stylistically rendered as charming, tactile clay models.

Subject 1, a male, and Subject 2, a female, will be positioned as miniature adventurers resting atop the cap of a giant, realistic red Fly Agaric mushroom with white spots. The composition should feel like a freeze-frame from a high-budget stop-motion film, with visible thumbprints on the clay surfaces, uneven, sculpted textures, and a clear sense of physicality.

The scene should be set on a macro-scale forest floor, with the mushroom as the central stage. Use a warm, soft studio lighting setup with simulated rim lighting to highlight the clay edges, creating a sense of depth and tactile realism. The camera angle should be a slight high-angle macro shot, with a shallow depth of field to simulate a miniature set and emphasize the tiny, handcrafted details.

The color palette should be vibrant and earthy, featuring rich reds, mossy greens, canary yellows, and sky blues. The overall atmosphere should be playful, handcrafted, tactile, and charming, evoking a sense of timeless whimsy.

The environment should include oversized blades of grass made of flattened green clay, a snail with a spiral shell made of rolled play-dough, and cotton-ball clouds in the background. The subjects should be integrated seamlessly into this miniature world, looking like they were sculpted from the same clay as their surroundings.

Subject 1 should be dressed in a textured hiker's vest made of matte clay, a plaid shirt with painted lines, and chunky brown boots. He should have a wide, friendly grin with slightly exaggerated, rounded features, sitting on the edge of the mushroom and pointing at a clay butterfly with a joyful expression.

Subject 2 should be kneeling on the mushroom cap, wearing a yellow raincoat with a smooth, glossy finish and oversized red rain boots. She should have a cheerful look with sculpted laugh lines and bright eyes, holding a giant, sculpted blueberry with both hands.

Ensure that the final image avoids any photorealistic skin, hair strands, or digital gloss. The style should be exclusively claymation, with no trace of 2D cartoon, sketch, anime, watercolor, or any other incompatible visual styles. The colors should be natural and earthy, excluding any neon, dark moody tones, or inappropriate color schemes.

The final scene should feel like a high-quality, professional claymation still, with a clear sense of tactile, handcrafted charm that would look right at home in a high-budget stop-motion film. Every element of the composition should serve to immerse the viewer in a world of whimsy and wonder, with the subjects being the central focus of the miniature adventure."

[/IMPROVED_PROMPT]
